title: Audit Report: Global Fund Grants in the Republic of Senegal, the Islamic Republic of Mauritania and the Republic of The Gambia (GF-OIG-24-005)
publisher: The Global Fund, Office of the Inspector General
why_not: A three-country audit whose one Senegal fact, malaria reporting completeness falling from 98% to 23% during the strikes, predates October 2023, is dated inconsistently in the text (Q2 2023 and Q4 2022) and is carried for 2023 by lead 2, a ministry source.
